M3.completed_evidence: Both RandomSpanLight arms complete 148/148 with exact 256 forwards, 0 duplicate/error, 444 birth/death events, and frozen test sealed. Fixed birth-death-vs-uniform task-macro delta=-4.05pp, help/harm=8/14; mean token-forward is lower but accuracy point estimate is lower.
